metadata.coastalSelection: Real mapped building height >40m or building:levels>12, within 1500m of OSM coast and on OSM land, in the selection bbox. Missing-height buildings are omitted; candidates are not confirmed light-show participants.
metadata.governmentPolicy: Main office identified by real building polygon containing the named city-government OSM node; adjacent named municipal offices kept separately. No commercial-map coordinate offset guesses.
limitations: OSM names and polygons may be incomplete. Geographic light-show candidate filtering is an estimate of the coastal cluster, not a surveyed performance roster.
Polygon positions are geometric centroids; point landmark positions are exact mapped OSM nodes.
May Wind is mapped as an artwork polygon, not a standalone point node. Its derived centroid is marked as a polygon-derived position.

cityGovernment.support: Official address is Hong Kong Middle Road 11, municipal phase-one office building; matches node/11432724805 address tags. Official page does not publish surveyed WGS84 coordinates.

mayFourthSquare.support: Officially south of municipal office building, north/south areas divided by Donghai Road; May Wind sculpture on sea-view platform. OSM geometry matches this arrangement. Official page does not publish surveyed WGS84 coordinates.

tvTower.support: Mapped named television communications tower polygon with explicit 232m OSM height tag. Exact official surveyed coordinates and height reference datum have not been independently confirmed.

plazaDetail.policy: True mapped grass/garden/pedestrian/water polygons and paths; relation holes retained. Park outline is not synonymous with grass. Node-only fountain footprint has no surveyed radius. Paths without width tag use a 2m visualization estimate.
